description: Welcome to Seggz n Bacon: Sex, Love, Unfiltered Truths where breaking silence becomes a superpower. Our Mission: Breaking the Silence to Find Sovereignty S.L.U.Ts (Sex, Love, Unfiltered Truths) The Heart of SeggznBacon are S.L.U.Ts! SEX, LOVE, & UNFILTERED TRUTHS is more than a philosophy, it's a sanctuary for the silenced voices of inner authority, resilient intuitives, and raw truth-seeking individuals, designed to guide others to move from quieted pain to empowered expression by bringing shadows to light. The community seeks to disrupt systemic patterns of behavior by speaking truths and facilitating personal growth through shared experience. A Healing Roadmap: Modalities for Sovereignty Episodes highlight actionable healing modalities, such as Tantra for energy connection, hypnotherapy for subconscious reprogramming, Reiki, mindfulness, somatic movement, and nature therapy, to guide listeners toward sovereignty. Explore taboo subjects, including sacred intimacy and pleasure as paths to divine embodiment, and dives into shadow work for holistic healing. Discussions also cover reclaiming personal power, analyzing the sex industry, navigating relationships, exploring true crime for deeper understanding, and leveraging the healing power of nature. Join us as we dive deep into: Divine Embodiment & Sacred Pleasure: Reconnecting with your body and sovereignty. Shadow Work & Integration: Healing the parts of ourselves we’ve been told to hide.
